subject: I made a huge mistake with this app
preview_text: Most users skip this feature. I almost did too. Don't be like me.
body_paragraphs: I thought I had SoulPlan figured out. Browse ideas, pick one, done. That's what I did for the first two days. Felt good. Then I stumbled onto something by accident, and I felt like an idiot for missing it.

Turns out, the best part of this app is the one thing everyone skips. The surprise date planner. My partner didn't know I was planning anything. I just set it up, picked a few options, and let the app do the rest. When they got the notification, their face lit up like I'd planned a surprise vacation.

Here's the thing: most couples never bother with this feature. They just scroll through ideas and pick one. But the magic is in the secret planning. You choose the vibe, the budget, and whether it's a total surprise or a hint. The app sends them a clue, they guess, it becomes a game. We've done it three times now, and every time feels like a mini-adventure.

Open SoulPlan right now. Go to the 'Plan a Surprise' tab. Start with a simple 'low-key romantic' option. That's it. P.S. The date history tracking will show you how many ideas you've tried—bet you'll want to beat your own score.
cta_text: Open SoulPlan and try the surprise planner
